source.title: Night City 2045
source.note: Direct source review of all eleven Reclamation Zone rows the v0.2 audit classified CONTEXT_ONLY. Factual metadata and concise paraphrases only; source prose is not reproduced.

entities.name: Country Cars
entities.source_summary: Converted NCART cars used as low-cost community housing for newcomers; the source describes residence and community life without a stated public rental transaction.

entities.name: Flashback
entities.source_summary: Retro-themed restaurant and bar attracting visitors from wealthier districts for food, atmosphere and canned Smash.

entities.name: Freddie Douglas School
entities.source_summary: Community all-ages school built in a reinforced shelter; no tuition or customer-facing paid education is stated.

entities.name: Gordon’s Garage
entities.source_summary: Tech-operated garage where residents bring vehicles for extensive repair and combat-oriented modification; apartments occupy the floors above.

entities.name: McGee Speedway
entities.source_summary: Community racetrack and park used for informal races, picnics, parties and occasional special events; no persistent paid venue service is stated.

entities.name: Herschel’s Crematorium
entities.source_summary: Longstanding family-run crematorium and funeral home providing respectful end-of-life care across cultures and creeds.

entities.name: La Perrera
entities.source_summary: Headquarters and jail for Los Perros Guardianes, also home to the unit's dog-breeding and training specialist; the training is for patrol animals rather than a public service.

entities.name: Metal Mountain
entities.source_summary: District junkyard and scrap heap used for refuse, salvage and recycling; the source suggests scavengable finds but does not establish a sales operation.

entities.name: Mobile Mosque Prayer Center
entities.source_summary: Expandable mobile mosque serving prayer and community needs while funds are raised for a permanent building; no customer-facing commerce is described.

entities.name: NCART Yards
entities.source_summary: Operational storage and maintenance yard for Night City's public buses and trains, with staff facilities and repair fleets; not a public customer-service point.

entities.name: Second City Solos Firing Range
entities.source_summary: Public firing range and social venue where 20eb buys ammunition, SCOPwings and use of a rifle selection; weekly sharpshooting competitions include owner-run betting.

local_offerings.label: Small-game ammunition, SCOPwings and rifle access package
